assay: bulk RNA-seq, subcutaneous white adipose tissue (S2.4.16.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 60 weeks of 20% EtOH in drinking water vs water (control) on subcutaneous WAT gene expression in aged female C57BL/6 mice (S2.2.p1, S3.4.p3). There is no exercise intervention: the treadmill was used only as a time-to-fatigue performance test (S2.4.2.p1, week 55), given to every mouse in both groups.
inclusion: 17 female mice (7 control, 10 EtOH); RNA-seq on 6 vs 6 (GEO); paper figure n 5-6 control / 6-9 EtOH (FIG7)
planned_contrasts: EtOH vs Control in WAT (S3.4.p3; paper: 61 DEGs, 47 down / 14 up)
repeated_measure_unit: none (one WAT sample per mouse at sacrifice)
paper_method: Rsubread featureCounts; keep genes mapped in >= 6 samples; DESeq2 v1.44.0 (S2.4.16.p1)
